candidates.change_summary: Delete the statement `rewardsForA[recipient] = 0;` so the reward balance is not zeroed before withdrawal.
Replace the amount computation with `uint amountToWithdraw = 0;` so no value is ever sent.
Delete `_locked = true;` so the reentrancy guard no longer blocks reentrant calls, exposing different end-state values.
Delete `_locked = false;` so the lock is never released and any subsequent withdrawReward call reverts, changing the observable end state.
Remove the statement `claimedBonus[recipient] = true;` so the bonus can be claimed multiple times.
Remove the call to `withdrawReward(recipient)` so the bonus reward is never paid out and stays in rewardsForA.
Move `claimedBonus[recipient] = true;` before the call to `withdrawReward(recipient)`, changing state visible to reentrant calls during the transfer.
Replace `rewardsForA[recipient] += 100;` with `rewardsForA[recipient] += 101;`, paying a different bonus amount.
Remove the statement that zeroes rewardsForA[recipient] before the transfer, so the reward is never reset and remains claimable repeatedly.
Remove the require(success) check so failed transfers no longer revert, leaving rewardsForA[recipient] already zeroed even when the ETH transfer fails.
Remove the unlock statement at the end of the modifier, so after any withdrawReward the contract stays locked and all subsequent withdrawReward calls revert.
Remove the lock acquisition in the modifier, disabling reentrancy protection so a reentrant call from recipient can drain rewardsForA during withdrawReward, changing observable state.
Delete the statement 'rewardsForA[recipient] += 100;' so no bonus reward is credited before withdrawal.
Replace 'rewardsForA[recipient] += 100;' with 'rewardsForA[recipient] += 101;' so one extra wei is credited and transferred.
Delete 'claimedBonus[recipient] = true;' so the bonus can be claimed repeatedly.
Delete the call 'withdrawReward(recipient);' so the credited reward is never paid out.
